'''Arribid Bensen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] under [[Darth Marr]] as [[Under-Moff]]. The title Under-Moff was created especially for Bensen as the top military engineer and geologist.<ref name="Codex" /><ref name="Rise" /><ref name="Codex" /><ref name="Rise" /> In [[3640 BBY]] Bensen was on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and witnessed the duel between [[Darth Thanaton]] and [[Darth Nox]] that ended the [[Kaggath]] between them.<ref name="Rise" /> Following the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Bensen was chosen by Darth Marr to oversee the mining of [[Isotope-5]] on the planet.<ref name="Codex" /><ref name="Rise" />

==Personality and traits==
Bensen appeared to be well informed of the [[Dark Council]] affairs of his day; he was aware of the demise of [[Darth Baras]] at the [[Empire's Wrath|"Emperor's Wrath"]] hands, and the fate of [[Darth Thanaton]] at [[Darth Nox]]'s.<ref name="Rise" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arribid Bensen first appeared in game update 2.0 [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|Rise of the Hutt Cartel]] of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]].
He is only accessible through the Contain and Control quest series of the Imperial players in the game on Makeb.
